verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for a payments API (for example, batch payouts or bulk wallet creation), but the evidence pack never documents any batch or bulk endpoint. Payment rules, single payouts, per-customer wallet creation and ledger report webhooks are per-item or adjacent automation features. None of them is a multi-item bulk operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
